verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's official documentation has dedicated guides to 'Install NVIDIA drivers' and 'Build your own NVIDIA modules using the DKMS package'. Ubuntu also positions itself as a primary platform for AI/ML software, which covers the core of installing GPU vendor drivers and building kernel modules for accelerated workloads. Older community remarks about proprietary blobs and mediocre drivers are dated sentiment, not a concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: evidence beyond doc page titles (no in-depth content), coverage of non-NVIDIA GPU vendors, general custom kernel module building beyond NVIDIA DKMS, and independent hands-on corroboration.
